answer: Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. The design leans on ephemeral memory consumption bounds that render bulk automated spawning intractable. Reaching the jade of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the pigment of a task receipt, and the walnut is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
